sources.note: The record's official_source_url. News item 'Abre la Convocatoria 2026-2027 a Becas de Investigación para Estudiantes' on the Facultad de Ciencias Médicas de la UNCUYO site (dated 28 de septiembre de 2026). Names the running unit, states eligibility, the 20 scholarships, the 210-hour structure, and the full two-stage timetable.

Programme page 'Becas de Investigación para Estudiantes. Convocatoria 2026-2027' linked as 'Bases del Programa' from the news item. Confirms the awarding unit (Dirección de Investigación y Relaciones Institucionales, Secretaría de Desarrollo Institucional), eligibility including the first-full-year rule, the individual/dupla modalities, the cronograma (student registration 9-20 November 2026), and that academic 'avales' carry no stipend.

The official 'Convocatoria 2026-2027 a Becas de Investigación para Estudiantes' bases PDF (22 pages) linked from the programme page. Read as extracted text. Gives the exact stipend amount (20 scholarships of $151.637,14 each), the 210-hour breakdown, the reserve-of-two-cupos rule, the evaluation steps and the annex forms.

awarding_body.detail: Both pages are the Facultad de Ciencias Médicas (FCM) of the Universidad Nacional de Cuyo's own site, and both attribute the programme to the same unit named in the record: the Dirección de Investigación y Relaciones Institucionales, which sits in the Secretaría de Desarrollo Institucional.
awarding_body.quote: La **Dirección de Investigación y Relaciones Institucionales** de la **Secretaría de Desarrollo Institucional**, presenta la convocatoria 2026-2027 de su **Programa de Becas de Investigación para Estudiantes**

deadline.detail: The record's 20 November 2026 deadline is the close of the student-registration stage of the cycle currently running today. The page states the call is in its first stage now (projects/directors 5-16 October 2026) and that student registration opens 9 November and closes 20 November 2026, with final awards in December 2026 and the scholarships starting 1 February 2027. The official bases PDF gives the same window ('9 al 20 de noviembre de 2026').
deadline.quote: La inscripción de estudiantes se realizará posteriormente, del 9 al 20 de noviembre de 2026, tanto para quienes se presenten individualmente como para quienes lo hagan en dupla.

eligibility.detail: Every distinct eligibility claim in the record is confirmed. The call is for regular students of Medicina, Licenciatura en Enfermería and Técnicos Asistenciales en Salud at FCM UNCUYO who have passed at least the first full year; students may apply individually or as a pair ('dupla'); and the projects and their directors are put forward by the faculty's own teacher-researchers, evaluated by the Comisión Asesora. The PDF adds that two of the 20 places are reserved for projects/directors in Enfermería and in the Escuela de Técnicos Asistenciales en Salud (minimum 60 points each), which does not contradict the record.
eligibility.quote: Podrán postularse **estudiantes regulares de Medicina**, **Licenciatura en Enfermería** y carreras de **Técnicos Asistenciales en Salud** de la **FCM UNCUYO** que tengan aprobado, como mínimo, el primer año completo de su carrera.

funding.detail: The 'Stipend' funding type is correct. The official bases state 20 scholarships of ARS 151,637.14 each - a monetary stipend for 210 clock-hours of research training, not a tuition waiver and not a fully funded award. The programme page corroborates that it is a stipend by stating the academic 'aval' alternative lets a student do the training 'sin estipendio'.
funding.quote: La FCM UNCUYO prevé la adjudicación de 20 becas por un monto de $151.637,14 cada una. La duración total será de 210 horas reloj, distribuidas de la siguiente manera: • 10 horas para el Curso de Metodología de la Investigación (ciclo formativo). • 200 horas para la ejecución del proyecto (ciclo de ejecución), distribuidas en un máximo de 6 meses consecutivos.

degree_levels.detail: The record's 'Bachelor's' is right in substance: the programme is for undergraduate (grado y pregrado) students still in their first degrees. The official wording is broader than the record's label - it covers 'estudiantes regulares universitarios/as de grado y pregrado', which includes the non-degree tertiary Técnicos Asistenciales en Salud programmes - but both describe study at the undergraduate level and the mismatch is labelling, not a different award.
degree_levels.quote: Esta nota deberá ser completada por estudiantes regulares universitarios/as de grado y pregrado de cualquiera de las carreras de la FCM UNCUYO que hayan aprobado, al menos, el primer año completo de su carrera.

recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Re-checked live 2026-10-12 against three official FCM UNCUYO pages: the record's URL (news item of 28 de septiembre de 2026), the programme page /becas-de-investigacion-para-estudiantes-de-la-fcm-convocatoria-20262027, and the 22-page bases PDF at /upload/89ececf7539f108e646845ab471874b8.pdf. Awarding unit, deadline, eligibility, funding and degree levels all agree with the record. Awarding body is internal to FCM (Dirección de Investigación y Relaciones Institucionales, Secretaría de Desarrollo Institucional) and the award is a research stipend, not a tuition waiver: 20 scholarships of ARS 151.637,14 each for 210 clock-hours (10h methodology course + 200h project, max 6 months). Stage 1 (projects/directors) ran 5-16 October 2026; admitted projects are published 2-6 November; student registration 9-20 November 2026; evaluation 30 November-11 December 2026; awards December 2026; scholarships start 1 February 2027. Caveat for the catalogue: applicants must already be regular, currently enrolled FCM UNCUYO students, so this is an internal award and is not open to prospective or international applicants. Next re-check: this cycle closes 20 November 2026 - re-check after mid-December 2026 for the award list, and around September-October 2027 for the 2027-2028 call.

notes_for_reviewer: One field-level wording point for a human: the catalogue's degree_levels value is 'Bachelor's', while the official pages say 'grado y pregrado', i.e. the call also covers the non-degree tertiary Técnicos Asistenciales en Salud programmes. The award, deadline, funding and eligibility are all confirmed as recorded, so I marked the record active; consider widening the degree_levels label to 'Bachelor's (grado y pregrado)'. Note also that the stipend figure and the two reserved places (Enfermería, Técnicos Asistenciales en Salud) come from the bases PDF, which I read as extracted text - they are not visible on either HTML page.
